plan.title: gate(agents-md): seed skillFrontmatterMaxBytes fail-closed DD-3 ratchet (daily-core 2080 B)

narratives.Description: Phase-3 insurance under #2531: seed plan.policy.agentsMdBudget.skillFrontmatterMaxBytes at the measured daily-core size (2080 B) and pin skillFrontmatterTier to daily-core so DD-3 frontmatter growth fails closed while the combined ≤8192 chase continues. Managed absoluteMaxBytes=7815 already fail-closed; this closes the advisory gap on skill frontmatter.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Set plan.policy.agentsMdBudget.skillFrontmatterMaxBytes=2080 and skillFrontmatterTier=daily-core in xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json. 2) CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Changed entry. 3) UPGRADING always-on budget note: framework tree now seeds the optional DD-3 ratchet. 4) Verify: task verify:agents-md-budget exits 0 and reports skill-frontmatter 2080/2080. No engine code changes — evaluate path already fail-closes when the field is set (#2463).
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want DD-3 skill frontmatter growth to fail closed at the current daily-core size, so Phase-3 combined-budget work cannot be silently undone by longer skill descriptions.
narratives.Origin: Operator spinout from closed #2491; parent epic #2531

narrative.Acceptance: Given PROJECT-DEFINITION agentsMdBudget, when read, then skillFrontmatterMaxBytes is 2080 and skillFrontmatterTier is daily-core.
Given task verify:agents-md-budget, when run on the directive tree, then exit 0 and skill-frontmatter reports 2080/2080 bytes.
